label: CommandCode
notes: Primary source: GET /internal/usage/charts?granularity=day&from=<ISO>&to=<ISO> (cookie, CORS) - daily x model x provider aggregates with cache tokens and cost; not capped.
The /internal/usage detail list is capped at 100 rows/window (limit=50/page, seen>=100 => 0) and has no cache split; not used for history.
Cost is vendor-reported (totalCost) via registry costSource:"vendor"; cacheReadInputTokens/cacheCreationInputTokens are native.
timeBucket is naive; treated as UTC.
No Export button - crawl is the only path.
